summary: Siskiyou NF ground site near Cave Junction, OR; L-4 cab built 1934, removed or destroyed in 1965; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register says the cab was removed in 1965; firelookout.com says destroyed that year. No source describes the site now.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the cab was removed in 1965; firelookout.com says it was destroyed that year. Both agree the cab was gone by 1965, so the story reports both wordings.

The register and firelookout.com date the cab to 1934, but the Siskiyou Bulletin already wrote about 'the new Tennessee Mountain Lookout station' in July 1932. The sources do not say whether that was the same structure, so the story gives both.
The timeline dates the road to 1936-1937, but a November 1931 Siskiyou Bulletin item already describes the road and telephone line as under construction. The story gives both.

notes_for_editor: Gone status is supported: the cab was removed or destroyed in 1965 per two sources. Sources conflict on removed vs destroyed, on the 1932 station mention vs the 1934 build date, and the November 1931 road item vs the 1936 road start. Access is left out of facts because no source says whether the site is open. No source describes remains or the view today. The Oregon Lookouts page has a 'Removed' heading with no text under it. The brief's record was accurate (ground site, FFLOS registration 2011-04-21, elevation 984 m). Used 2 fallback web searches and about 9 page reads.
